summary: Crispy Hanukkah latkes from just Russet potato, onion, egg and salt: salt the grated potato and onion for 15 minutes, wring out as much water as possible, and fry flattened 1/3-inch cakes in about 1/8 inch of oil until deep brown.
glance: about 1 pound (450 grams) of potato per person as a main course
450 grams potato to 115 grams onion, 1 egg, about 5 grams kosher salt
salt and let sit 15 minutes, then wring dry
in about 1/8 inch of oil over medium-high heat
yield: 1 pound of potato per person as a main course
faq: What is the key to crispy latkes?

Extracting as much water from the potatoes as possible. Pre-salt them for 15 minutes, then wring them in cheesecloth or a clean towel, or squeeze them in a heavy-duty potato ricer. Otherwise they will spit water in the pan and come out mushy.
How do I keep grated potatoes from turning black?

Grate them not long before frying. If you must grate early, press plastic wrap tightly on the surface and refrigerate. You can also crush a plain unflavored 500 mg vitamin C tablet for every 4 pounds of potato and toss it in with the salt.
How much oil and what temperature?

About 1/8 inch of oil over medium-high heat. A bit of potato thrown in should sizzle immediately, but the oil shouldn't smoke. Don't be stingy: the latkes absorb the same amount anyway, but with less oil they won't be properly crispy.
How big should latkes be?
Use about 1/4 to 1/3 cup of potato and flatten to about 1/3 inch right away, so the inside cooks before the outside burns. Flip when the first side is a dark, deep brown.
Can I keep latkes crispy for a crowd?
Latkes are best fresh from the pan. Fry as many at a time as possible, keep them on a baking sheet and re-crisp at 400 degrees, or serve standing up straight from the pan to the plate.
How much potato per person?
About 1 pound (450 grams) per person as a main course for the author's family, or half that as an appetizer.
How should I adjust for kosher salt brands?
The author uses Diamond Crystal. If using another brand by volume, reduce all amounts by around 40%; measuring by weight is best.

summary: Chanterelle tostadas: chanterelles sauteed about 5 minutes with salt and cumin, piled on refried bean-spread tostada shells with tomato, radish, jalapeno, sweet onion and cilantro, without an intense salsa.
glance: 4 small tostadas, a light main course
faq: Why no intense salsa on chanterelle tostadas?
The challenge is to use chanterelles so their unique flavor and texture isn't overwhelmed by big flavors, so these have just a scattering of tomatoes, onions, radish and jalapeno.
How do you cook chanterelles for tostadas?

Heat a tablespoon of vegetable oil in a heavy skillet over medium-high heat, add the cleaned mushrooms with a pinch of salt and a pinch of cumin, and cook, stirring occasionally, until tender and aromatic, about 5 minutes.
Can I make my own tostada shells?
Yes, pan-fry corn tortillas in a shallow layer of oil. The recipe uses four six-inch shells; multiply by 1.5 if using larger shells.
Are chanterelles only for European dishes?
No. Chanterelles and other wild mushrooms are used throughout the world, from Mexico to the Himalayas, though those uses rarely travel to the US with the cuisines.
How many does this serve?
Four small tostadas make a light main course; double the recipe if you aren't serving much else.

summary: Bocoles are pan-fried masa and mashed black bean cakes, here topped with a spicy yam filling and crema for an unusual vegetarian entree adapted from Diana Kennedy's My Mexico; fry about 3 or 4 minutes.
glance: 6 as an entree or 12 as an appetizer
golf-ball-sized balls patted to 1/4 inch, 3 or 4 minutes in 1/8 inch of oil
yams, onion, garlic and jalapeno with cumin
Vegetarian and gluten-free; vegan if you omit the crema
yield: 6 as an entree or 12 as an appetizer
faq: What are bocoles?
Little pan-fried cakes of masa and mashed black beans, typically served as an antojito (appetizer). They fry up with a crispy exterior and a somewhat creamy inside.
Where can I find fresh masa?
Look for a tortilleria, a place that makes fresh corn tortillas. If you don't have fresh masa, buy masa harina and mix it per the package directions for tortillas.
What if I can't find prepared refried black beans?
Fry some onion and garlic with canned black beans and puree thoroughly with enough liquid to make a smooth paste.
How long do bocoles take to fry?
About 3 or 4 minutes in 1/8 inch of oil over medium heat, until brown outside and cooked but still soft inside. Diana Kennedy says 7 minutes per side, but the author found it took less; try a tester.
How do you cut the yams for the filling?
Make strips with a mandoline, then cut the strips into very small cubes.
What do you serve with bocoles?
A bed of shredded romaine hearts, the yam filling and crema, plus salsa or a jicama, radish and orange salad, and optionally mole or pipian.

summary: Tea-smoked lychee amuse bouche: fresh lychee halves cold-smoked about 10 minutes over genmaicha tea in a covered pot, chilled, and served with a chilled genmaicha broth, grated ginger, microgreens and sea salt.
glance: about 10 minutes on the lowest heat, over 3 tablespoons of genmaicha
chilled, with a spoonful of chilled tea broth
faq: How do you smoke lychee with tea?

Put 3 tablespoons of genmaicha tea in the bottom of a small pot, set the lychee halves on a rack or inverted metal cup inside, cover and heat on the lowest setting. After about 5 minutes check that there is smoke, raising the heat a bit if not, and smoke for about 10 minutes. Then chill thoroughly.
What is genmaicha?
A green tea with toasted brown rice.
How do you pit a fresh lychee?
Peel it, split the fruit in half with a paring knife and carefully remove the pit. It is a little tricky, so you'll probably muck up a few; you only need four good halves.
Where can I buy fresh lychees?
At a good Asian grocery or a high-end produce shop; the author has even seen them at Trader Joe's. They are far better than canned.
How do I make the broth?
Brew the remaining tablespoon of tea with a cup of boiling water for a few minutes, then strain and chill.

summary: Chickpea cakes (fritters) of pulsed chickpeas, green onion, garlic, rosemary, lemon, egg, flour, breadcrumbs and sesame seeds, pressed into 3-inch patties and shallow-fried about 3 minutes per side; makes about 16 small cakes.
glance: about 3 minutes on the first side, then brown the other
faq: How are chickpea cakes different from falafel?
They are somewhat like a pan-fried falafel, but without the benefit of a deep-fried crust, so the internal flavoring is amped up.
How should the chickpea mixture feel?

Buzz it in the food processor until fairly uniform but before it is completely pureed, so some texture remains. You should be able to form it into a ball that holds its shape, neither crumbly nor a batter. Add liquid or breadcrumbs as needed.
How do I fry chickpea cakes?

Heat a few tablespoons of oil in a large skillet, preferably cast-iron, over medium-high heat. Press golf-ball-sized pieces into flattened 3-inch patties, fry until golden brown, about 3 minutes, then flip and brown the other side. Drain on paper towels and finish with sea salt.
Can I make chickpea cakes vegan or gluten-free?
Use an egg-replacer for vegan, and gluten-free breadcrumbs and an alternative flour for gluten-free.
How do I serve them?
As an appetizer, a side dish on an entree plate, or as the protein-packed star, with tomato jam.

faq: Is curry powder made from curry leaves?
No. Good Indian cooks mix spices for individual dishes. Curry leaves can be ground into a powder called karuvepilai podi, but that is not curry powder.
Where do I find curry leaves?
At an Indian grocery or a very well-stocked pan-Asian grocery. They freeze rather well, so it's fine to buy more than you will use right away.
Can I substitute bay leaves for curry leaves?
No. They aren't even vaguely similar, and curry leaves are edible when crisped up, while bay leaves are not.
What do curry leaves taste like?
They are incredibly aromatic, in a way that smells something like sesame and nuts.
How do I boil potatoes so they don't fall apart?
Start them in cold water, which gives the inside a chance to come up to temperature before the outside overcooks and falls apart. Cook until completely tender when pierced but not falling apart.
How do I know the curry leaves are crisp?
Stir-fry in the melted butter until they begin to crisp, about 3 minutes, and pull one out and let it cool a few seconds to test it.
